purpose: Teach: とおし/うける/ぐち/たいそう/囲い/甘かっ/質素/ガバ

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: リク、文化祭、準備、ぶっとおしで、やってたよね、皆。
lines.en: Riku, you guys were really going nonstop with the festival prep, weren't you.
lines.style: Dry observation, almost sardonic. Slight lean back. Casual rhythm, like she's checking in on something she already suspects.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: うん。お前の漫才、後輩にうけるよな、桜。
lines.en: Yeah. Your comedy bit kills with the underclassmen, you know.
lines.style: Lighter, more genuine warmth breaking through. Quick rhythm, a small smile in the voice. Genuine compliment underneath the ease.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスメイト、たまにぐち、言うよね、テストのこと。
lines.en: Classmates keep mentioning tests to me — complaining about how they went.
lines.style: Thoughtful, listening-back tone. Slight pause before speaking. Not judgmental, just observing what she's noticed. Quiet sincerity.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 昨日の試合、たいそう疲れたわ、本当。
lines.en: Yesterday's match really wiped me out, honestly.
lines.style: Tired exhale underneath. Dry delivery masking genuine fatigue. Slower pace on the back half, slight drift of admission.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 校庭の囲い、新しく塗ったって、聞いたよ。
lines.en: Oh, I heard they painted the schoolyard fence new colors.
lines.style: Lifting slightly, genuinely curious. Eyebrow-raise in the voice. Brighter pace — she's changing subject deliberately to lighten it.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: お弁当のおかず、甘かったね、今日は。
lines.en: The side dishes in lunch were really sweet today, weren't they.
lines.style: Small, half-present observation. Conversational filler with a tiny edge of tiredness. Like he's talking to stay connected but his mind is elsewhere.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: うちの家計、質素な感じだから、無理しないでね、リク。
lines.en: My family keeps things pretty simple financially, so don't feel like you have to do anything extra for me, okay.
lines.style: Soft opening, careful. Gentle but direct — not asking permission, setting a boundary kindly. Warm underneath, no apology in the tone.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 試験前、ガバッと布団から、飛び起きたよ、俺。
lines.en: This morning before the test, I literally bolted straight up out of bed.
lines.style: Sudden energy on the opening word. Quick, almost embarrassed rhythm — the admission of panic underneath the wry delivery. Self-deprecating laugh underneath.
